dialogues.speaker: Uhane
dialogues.text: Welcome to Paititi — the place of your dreams! *hic*...

response.speaker: Uhane
response.text: Paititi is Tete Isle, and Tete Isle is Paititi! *hic*...

response.speaker: Uhane
response.text: Which means the treasure buried on Tete Isle is the mysterious treasure of the golden country of Paititi...

response.speaker: Uhane
response.text: How's that for a secret, huh?! *hic*...

response.speaker: Uhane
response.text: Hehe, why would I lie to you? I know it's real because it was buried by the resort authorities.

response.speaker: Uhane
response.text: Even though it was put here to attract customers, it's still a real treasure. So let's see who's lucky enough to find it...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Can you tell me where it is?

response.speaker: Uhane
response.text: Of course not! ...What are you looking at me like that for? Honestly...

response.speaker: Uhane
response.text: ...Ugh, fine, fine. Just stop giving me those sad puppy eyes, and I'll give you a hint!

response.speaker: Uhane
response.text: Look in the northern part of Tete Isle. That's all I'll say, and that's all you need. *hic*...
